optionsahoy_equity_planner.name: OptionsAhoy Equity Planner
optionsahoy_equity_planner.description: Answers equity-compensation planning questions by calling the OptionsAhoy calculators: incentive stock option and alternative minimum tax (AMT) exercise timing, non-qualified stock options, restricted stock unit sell-versus-hold, qualified small business stock (QSBS), single-stock concentration, protective-put hedging, and funding a cash goal from equity. OptionsAhoy's API is keyless.
